papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Open-Domain QA
papers.problem: Open-domain question answering requires access to large knowledge bases that cannot fit in model parameters
papers.method: Dense passage retrieval with a FAISS index combined with a generative reader model

papers.title: Improving Factuality via Retrieved Context
papers.problem: Language models hallucinate facts not present in training data leading to unreliable outputs
papers.method: RAG pipeline with bi-encoder retrieval and cross-attention fusion of retrieved passages

papers.title: Hybrid Sparse-Dense Retrieval for Knowledge-Intensive NLP
papers.problem: Single-mode retrieval misses complementary signal from both lexical and semantic matching
papers.method: Hybrid BM25 and dense retrieval with late fusion for knowledge intensive NLP tasks

papers.title: Adaptive Retrieval for Long-Context Synthesis
papers.problem: Fixed retrieval budgets waste context on irrelevant passages during multi-hop reasoning
papers.method: Iterative retrieval augmented generation with learned stopping criteria

papers.title: RLHF: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
papers.problem: Pre-trained language models do not reliably follow human intent or avoid harmful outputs
papers.method: Proximal policy optimisation with a learned reward model trained on human preference data

papers.title: Reward Shaping for Sparse Reward Environments
papers.problem: Reinforcement learning agents fail to learn in environments with infrequent reward signals
papers.method: Actor-critic with intrinsic motivation reward signal based on curiosity-driven exploration

papers.title: Multi-Agent Cooperative Reinforcement Learning
papers.problem: Independent agents fail to coordinate optimally in cooperative multi-agent environments
papers.method: Centralised critic decentralised actor architecture for multi-agent policy learning

papers.title: Sample-Efficient Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.problem: Online RL requires expensive environment interaction making it impractical for real-world deployment
papers.method: Conservative Q-learning on static offline datasets with pessimistic value estimation

papers.title: Contrastive Vision-Language Pre-training at Scale
papers.problem: Image pixels and text tokens occupy incompatible representation spaces making vision-language alignment difficult
papers.method: Dual encoder with image CNN and text transformer trained via InfoNCE contrastive objective on image-caption pairs

papers.title: Multimodal Instruction Tuning with Visual Scene Grounding
papers.problem: Uni-modal language models cannot process pixel-level visual inputs or spatially ground referring expressions
papers.method: Visual token projection layer connecting image encoder to instruction-tuned language decoder with cross-modal attention
